parent.content:
Dear Cato I am still yours, a peak body
or Union of International Associations
and your distant honest Fruit Tree of
protected tended order and your buffer overrun
and will you need me any more? once
the new editions of the word en-Masse
are in harmony? Dear Cato I am inlaid
with business documents and school-books.

▧▧
parent.readme: What Paul Otlet might have worried about, when he was trying to hold it together.
